It doesn't boast the highest firepower, but the special metal it's crafted from prioritizes durability.|Inventory|BotW}} are recurring [[Item]]s in {{TLoZ Series}}. ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Bow |strength = 15 |durability = 40 |flammable = No |magnetic = Yes |buoyant = No |conductive = Yes |guardian = No |throw = |throw_effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract|Silver Bow}} Silver Bows are [[Bow]]s that were originally made for fishing, and because of this, they do not bear high attack power. However, they do have a higher durability due to the special metal they're crafted from. They belong to the [[Zora Gear]] equipment archetype, which includes [[Weapon]]s created by the [[Zora]].{{Cite Book|quote= |book= CaC |publisher= |page= 173}} Commonly, they are found in the [[Lanayru Great Spring]], particularly around [[Zora's Domain]], as well as in the [[Akkala Highlands]]. Many [[Lizalfos]] in these areas utilize them. Being made of metal, Silver Bows will conduct [[Electricity]] and attract [[Lightning]] if they are equipped during a [[Thunderstorm]]. They will also sink if they are dropped in [[Water (Terrain)|Water]], but they can be picked up with the [[Magnesis]] [[Rune]] on the [[Sheikah Slate]].
